product_metadata.title: 4 Stainless Steel Straws and 8 Silicone Straws with 2 Cleaning Brushes, Reusable Silicone and Metal Drinking Straws for 20oz 30oz Stainless Tumbler Yeti Rambler Rtic Ozark Trail Complete Bundle
features: PACK of 12: 4 extra-long stainless steel straws and 8 reusable silicone drinking straws with 2 cleaning brushes. All 10.5 inches length.
BPA FREE: Non-toxic and does not leave a rubbery and/or metallic after taste. Meets USA drinking straw standards. Lab tested. Flexible safe straws for kids.

Set of 4 STAINLESS STEEL STRAWS: Made of food-grade 18/8 stainless steel. And with an outer diameter of 0.25 inches, these straws can easily fit through the lid slot of the 20oz and 30oz stainless tumblers.
SET of 8 ASSORTED COLORFUL BIG SILICONE STRAWS: Made of 100% premium food-grade silicone. 4 pieces are 0.35-inch inner diameter and 4 pieces are 0.24-inch inner diameter.

Compatible with most 20 oz. and 30 oz. tumblers, including such popular brands as Yeti, Rtic, Bubba, Ozark, Klean Kanteen, ELLO, Contigo, Aladdin, Starbucks, Tervis, Simple Modern, and more. Fun for a party and trendy for a family reunion, girl’s night out, cocktail party, patio BBQ, picnics, boating and more. Great gift choice for your families and friends.
description: What's the newest trend in drinking straw world? A stainless steel and silicone drinking straw.
10.5" length is a perfect fit for your 30oz travel rumbler tumbler, tall glasses of juice or cocktails or to use in your insulated thermos or cooler mug.
The complete drinking straw bundle contains 8 silicone straws, 4 stainless steel straws and 2 brushes.
